outcome.statement: Reduce cold-start to first validated chart/schema/trace insight on >=100 MB local datasets from >8,000 ms (Electron/JVM incumbents) to <200 ms with 0 telemetry leaks and 100% perceptual Lie-Factor compliance.

opportunities.need: Developers and analysts struggle when opening 100 MB - 2 GB CSV/log files because Excel truncates at 1,048,576 rows and Electron viewers consume >1.2 GB RAM.

solutions.name: POSIX mmap Zero-Copy String-View Columnar Scanner + L1-Resident FNV-1a Hash Aggregator
solutions.assumption_test: Benchmark 250,000 rows (10 MiB) full scan + Welford moments + SHA-256 in <200 ms with <16 MiB RSS.

solutions.name: Multi-threaded chunked stdio fread pipeline
solutions.assumption_test: Compare syscall overhead against mmap + madvise(MADV_SEQUENTIAL).

opportunities.need: Analysts struggle to trust AI- or spreadsheet-generated charts and citations because truncated baselines, dual axes, and hallucinated DOIs slip into stakeholder decks.

solutions.name: Deterministic 15-Point Pre-Flight Perceptual Auditor (Cleveland-McGill + Lie Factor) & Epistemic Citation Verifier
solutions.assumption_test: Catch 100% of Lie Factor > 1.05 distortions and Type I-V citation failures in automated CI tests.

solutions.name: Post-hoc LLM vision critique of exported PNG charts
solutions.assumption_test: Compare latency and determinism against mathematical AST/scale verification.
